entries.test: Public outputs from Imagen 4 on the cited noncanonical prompts would show whether its accuracy remains comparably poor to its horse-riding-astronaut results.
entries.note: The immediate comparison is with the preceding failed test, and the claim is limited to some noncanonical prompts.

entries.test: Public comparisons with earlier Imagen outputs would establish whether text rendering improved overall, while tests of requested watch times other than 10:10 would establish their accuracy.
entries.note: “Dreadful” has a concrete performance reading here: watches fail to display the requested time. Improvement in general allows the explicitly noted unsuccessful image.

entries.test: Public controlled tests of Imagen's interpretation and rendering of ordinary versus noncanonical prompts would establish whether failures to understand the requested relationships account for unreliable prompt adherence.
entries.note: Marcus explicitly endorses the earlier point and extends it to the current system. The stated explanation makes causal the appropriate kind.
